column3: in the lifting of the earth
the mountain bearing the earth like a mushroom
of one devoid of dharma and desire
wishing dharma, wealth, desire and liberation
by dharma, knowledge, dispassion, prosperity, austerity, learning, action and so on
endowed with dharma, knowledge, calm, practising austerity till the end of the kalpa
by dharma, knowledge and so on
of those who see dharma, unrighteousness
striving for the protection of dharma
chief in dharma, one of them is the protector of these
upholder of dharma among the good
kings after the sacrifice of dharma
teaching dharma by example to those ignorant of it
knower of dharma placed on the head
dharma four-footed, upheld by those people
and dharma, giver of joy of the Self
the lords of the clan of Yudhishthira
the dharmas, the teacher of the world, Hari
family of the treasure of dharma
for gaining the cow-milk of dharma and wealth
descended with great deed to protect dharma
when people are driven by the goads of dharma-opposers
resorted to deceit in the guise of dharma
of one for whom dharma is the sole aim
by the dharmas of men who have offered themselves, Uddhava
this is the mark of dharma
to the side of the row
O Creator, creation of the qualities
O Creator, you deserve to know
and elements because of having parts
dressed like a dancer with mineral paints and sprouts, leaning on the shoulder
of those proud of their abode
melts away with streams from elephant trunks
running in the ten directions within
the helpless run after one running
having welcomed with intellect, of the self-possessed
of the intellect in the chest
of one pleased in his abode
the intellect is withdrawn in me
the intellect of single devotees of me is divided by blessings
Dhundhu's vehicle, Anakas, bells and so on
for the welfare of the bearer
in the science of the yoke
being wiped, with the drops of Shiva's water shaken off
Dhumraksha, Durmukha, Surantaka, Narantaka and others
with smoke-grey garments, fine garlands, bodices and faces
observing the Lord's vows, with garment of black antelope skin
making drink and bathe as with held water drops
unattainable even by yogis who hold the Self
the best mountain held by him
the mountain held in the churning of nectar
with cups of the senses repeatedly
of those whose Self is made by the fame of Hrishikesha
of the meditator, the thunderbolt hurled on the mountain of mental stains
having meditated on the upward-faced, awakened eight-petalled lotus
four-armed on the path of meditation
by joy of the embrace of Achyuta attained through meditation
from meditation on the Lord, by hearing the tales of his devotees
meditating on the destroyer of inauspiciousness
meditating on the lower fire-stick and upper
should meditate in the cave of one's body of the one who is established
should meditate looking at the tip of the nose
should meditate on the mind-made one, unwearied
the seeker of liberation should meditate on this of mine
the Self should not be meditated
in the form to be meditated on
is held for the child's sake
and Dhruva, both to each other
Vraja marked with feet bearing banner, thunderbolt, goad, lotus
form of marks like banner, thunderbolt, goad
with the affliction of the inner self destroyed
flow of qualities destroyed, by oneness with the Self
Brahma and lords of heaven whose blessings are destroyed
at night, with no kinsman seen
at night, you with no kinsman seen
in the glow of the nails
in the lustre of the nails
to remove our inner sin by the lustre of nails
torn out the heart-lotus with the nail tips
adorned with reddish jewels in nails
they suffer in the river carrying nails, bones, fat, flesh, marrow
robbed of his own splendour by moons of nails, approached covered
with fingers split by the moon rays of nails, beautiful petals
towns and villages, unattached, entered unnoticed
in the great dharma of hearing...
soon dissolves by company of the Lord
like an actor of great splendour
the two actors in excellent dress
when the immortal trumpets were sounding
roaring fiercely with the roaring ones
in a lake with sounding birds, bees and tumult
rivers, mountains, valleys, pools and groves
for the son of Nanda the cowherd
Nanda the cowherd and others in front
Nanda's son, dressed in wonderful costume
Nanda and others, agitated by wonder
Nanda, Upananda, Kritaka, Shura and others
indeed the Lord serves even the ignorant
surely for the offence of one
in the cloud-darkness of the rainy season, lights
with the mouth deep as the sky
the foot-lotus worth saluting for the lesser
having bowed to the Self-born forms, auspicious things
salutation to you of unbearable speed
salutation to you of unbearable speed, three powers, all the qualities of intelligence
salutation to you, deity of all mantras
salutation to you, the substance of all mantras' deities
salutation to you of infallible activity
salutation to you, of inexpressible form
salutation to you of unattached vision
salutation to the ripening of unrighteousness
salutation to the Self within and without
salutation to the unattached, secluded witness
with the magnanimous flute sounds of sweet notes among embodied beings
the root of the eye, endless
the abode of hells, orders of worlds
